mapper.select: select file_id, delivery_id, file_name, file_type, file_url, file_size, create_by, create_time from sys_delivery_file where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} order by file_id asc
select file_id, delivery_id, file_name, file_type, file_url, file_size, create_by, create_time from sys_delivery_file where file_id = #{fileId} limit 1

select f.file_id, f.file_name, f.file_url, f.file_size, d.delivery_id, d.delivery_no, d.order_id, d.work_id, d.buyer_id, d.seller_id, d.completed_time, d.confirm_time, o.order_no, w.title as work_title, w.cover as work_cover, us.nick_name as seller_name from sys_delivery_file f inner join sys_delivery d on f.delivery_id = d.delivery_id left join sys_order o on d.order_id = o.order_id left join sys_work w on d.work_id = w.work_id left join sys_user us on d.seller_id = us.user_id where d.buyer_id = #{buyerId} and d.status = 'completed' and f.file_type = 'cert'
and ( w.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or us.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or f.file_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by ifnull(d.completed_time, d.confirm_time) desc, f.file_id desc
